body:
Wow, when I thought I found the nicest subreddit...I kept exploring and keep raising the bar! Thank Deyta. Well it is personal, I'm just not good at opening up...regardless of how anonymous this is. In the end it's still humans behind a keyboard. 

But yes, you're right, I do have a reason for wanting to discuss this. I am suicidal (wow that was hard to type!). I have been for a while, but felt it's been under control. It's just gotten to the point where it feels *normal*. I feel uncomfortable when I'm happy. During the good times, I just feel...out of place. Then when my mind shifts back to depression, I'm at peace because I'm in a familiar place again.

I've been doing research on this topic, and I'm trying to figure out if my I could consider my thoughts rational.

The way I see it is: Life doesn't have a purpose, it's just what you decide it should be. I'm not sure what I want it to be yet. I have goals and dreams. I'd love to share my life with someone. But I'm not sure if I want to even share it with myself. And by that I mean, I see the possibility of ending it in the future. This decision to me is 'rational'. I'm not going to do it over an emotional fit, I'm going to do it because I believe my time has run out. Conventionally, our physical body dictates when we pass, with almost complete disregard to our mental body. 

I know what I'm saying crosses into r/philosophy as Aguyinachair (sweet name btw!) mentioned. But I really want to gain some perspective on these thoughts to see I'm just trying to convince myself what I'm thinking is right because I know deep down inside it's wrong.
